items.exampleEn: One drawback of working from home is feeling lonely.
items.exampleZh: 在家工作的一個缺點是會覺得寂寞。

items.exampleEn: During her induction, she met every team in the company.
items.exampleZh: 入職訓練期間，她認識了公司裡的每個團隊。

items.exampleEn: The rainforest is famous for its diversity of plants and animals.
items.exampleZh: 雨林以動植物的多樣性聞名。

items.exampleEn: We worked within the constraints of a small budget.
items.exampleZh: 我們在小額預算的限制下工作。

items.exampleEn: The new parking rules provoked strong reactions from drivers.
items.exampleZh: 新的停車規定引起駕駛們強烈的反應。

items.exampleEn: Every sport has its own inherent dangers.
items.exampleZh: 每項運動都有它本身固有的危險。

items.exampleEn: Her paintings evoke the quiet beauty of the countryside.
items.exampleZh: 她的畫喚起了鄉間寧靜的美。

items.exampleEn: After the sudden change of boss, the office was in turmoil for weeks.
items.exampleZh: 老闆突然換人後，辦公室亂了好幾個星期。

items.sentenceEn: New staff attend a two-day induction before they start work.
items.sentenceZh: 新員工在開始上班前，要參加兩天的入職訓練。

items.audioEn: The only drawback of the new apartment is the long walk to the station.
items.audioZh: 新公寓唯一的缺點，是走到車站要很久。
options: It is far from the station.

items.sentenceEn: His careless comment provoked an angry reply.
items.sentenceZh: 他輕率的一句話引來了憤怒的回應。

items.sentenceEn: This old song evokes the summer I spent in Tainan.
items.sentenceZh: 這首老歌讓我想起在台南度過的那個夏天。

items.stemEn: Time is the biggest ____ on this project; we have only two weeks.
items.stemZh: 時間是這個專案最大的限制，我們只有兩個星期。

items.stemEn: Some risk is ____ in any new business.
items.stemZh: 任何新事業都本來就有一些風險。

items.passageEn: Our city's food festival celebrates the diversity of its residents, with dishes from more than thirty countries. Last year, however, the event fell into turmoil when heavy rain left the main square under water. The organizers moved everything to a nearby school, but the change provoked complaints about long lines. This year, they have accepted the constraint of a smaller space and limited the number of stalls. Selling tickets online in advance has also proved advantageous. The only drawback is that some popular stalls are missing. Still, many visitors say the festival evokes the warm feeling of a family meal.
items.passageZh: 我們城市的美食節慶祝居民的多元，有來自三十多個國家的菜餚。然而去年，一場大雨讓主廣場積滿了水，活動陷入一片混亂。主辦單位把一切搬到附近的一所學校，但這個改變引起大家抱怨排隊太久。今年，他們接受了場地較小的限制，也限制了攤位數量。事先在網路上賣票也證明很有好處。唯一的缺點是少了一些熱門攤位。儘管如此，許多遊客說，這個美食節喚起了家庭聚餐的溫暖感覺。

questions.questionZh: 去年的活動為什麼陷入混亂？
options: 大雨讓主廣場積滿了水

questions.questionZh: 今年唯一的缺點是什麼？
options: 排隊時間比以前更長了

items.promptZh: 這個方法本身就有一些風險。
referenceEn: There are some inherent risks in this method.
This method has some inherent risks.
rubricZh: inherent 表示「固有的、本身就有的」（例如 inherent risks 等）
可寫，例如 There are…in…，也可寫 This method has… 等

items.promptZh: 這所大學很重視學生背景的多元性。
referenceEn: This university values the diversity of its students' backgrounds.
The university places great value on the diversity of its students.
rubricZh: 「多元性」用 diversity（例如 the diversity of its students 等）
「重視」可寫，例如 values、places great value on、cares about 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：heavy rain covered the main square in water 搭配不自然（多說 flooded the main square 或 left the main square under water）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "heavy rain left the main square under water"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：同課兩題 mcq 共用干擾項 diversity，且 q14 只有一個干擾項放得進形容詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q14 改為 isolated、spacious（先前課形容詞，放得進 is ____ in 但語意不通）與 evoke

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：induction 例句「Scientists use induction to form general rules from many examples.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「入職訓練」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「During her induction, she met every team in the company.」示範第一義；釋義為「入職訓練；歸納法」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：inherent 表示「固有的、本身就有的」（例如 inherent risks 等）／可寫，例如 There are…in…，也可寫 This method has… 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：diversity 表示「多元、多樣性」（例如 the diversity of the food 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（diversity）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u07-l01-q17；目標字沿用 diversity
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這所大學很重視學生背景的多元性。」、hintWords ["diversity"]、referenceEn ["This university values the diversity of its students' backgrounds.","The university places great value on the diversity of its students."]、rubricZh ["「多元性」用 diversity（例如 the diversity of its students 等）","「重視」可寫，例如 values、places great value on、cares about 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 diversity 造一個句子，說說你的城市、學校或公司的多元性。」、referenceEn ["I love the diversity of the food in my city.","My company values the diversity of its staff."]）
